# Tymor 1.2.2
## ✨ What's new
- Open **Arrange Screen Lights…** and **Arrange Window Lights…** directly from the menu bar’s **Lights** menu. - Arrange screen lights directly on your display. Drag hooks along any enabled edge and use the floating panel to fine-tune their positions. - If effects or sounds aren’t working, use **Settings → About → Export Diagnostics…** to save a report you can review and share with support.
## ⚡ Improvements
- Select hooks with numbered buttons that highlight the current selection. Switch between screen edges with an inline selector. - Lower individual hooks up to 120 points in both arrangement editors. - Move the floating screen-light editor more smoothly while Tymor pauses animated effects on the display you’re editing. Effects resume when you close the editor.
## 🐞 Bug fixes
- Fixed a startup issue that could leave weather and lights invisible even when enabled. If the graphics device is temporarily unavailable, Tymor now retries so effects can start without relaunching the app.

# Tymor 1.2.1
## ✨ What's new
- Give your snowman a Classic, Sunny, Wink, Sleepy, Joyful, or Surprised face in Winter settings. Choose Mix to shuffle your favorites as you build new snowmen.
## ⚡ Improvements
- Choose which preset colors to mix for top hats and scarves independently. Keep two to alternate between them, or leave one selected to use it every time. Custom colors are still available as a fixed choice.

# Tymor 1.2.0
## ✨ What's new
- Choose between the classic decorated Christmas tree and the new Snowy Spruce in Winter settings. - Penguin chicks visit in flocks, leaving footprints as they waddle through the snow. They belly-slide past one another and hop on and off the Dock. Click a walking chick and it waves hello. - When the snowplow approaches, chicks turn and slide out of its path or take shelter on the Dock. If the plow blocks their way down, they line up on the edge until it passes. - Choose how many penguins visit in Winter settings. Turn on **Automatic penguin visits** or select **Bring Penguins Now** to call the flock.
## ⚡ Improvements
- Snow along the bottom of the screen has gentler ripples for a smoother belly slide over the drifts.
